senses.gloss: m.(b. h., from which μνᾶ, [one hundred,] Maneh, a weight in gold or silver, equal to one hundred common or fifty sacred shekels (v. Zuckerm. Talm. Münz. p. 7, sq.).
units: Bekh. 5ᵃ מ׳ של קודש כפול היה the sacred Maneh was double the weight of the common.
Ib. VIII, 7 במ׳ צורי taking the Tyrian M. as a standard.
<cite ref="Bekhorot 49b:12">Ib. 49ᵇ</cite> <he>מ׳ צורי</he> … <he>מ׳ של צורי</he> ‘the Tyrian M.’ … means the standard of the Tyrian system (one Sela = 4 Zuz, Rashi).

<cite ref="Mishnah Ketubot 1:2">Keth. I, 2</cite> <he>בתולה … מאתים ואלמנה מ׳</he> the widowhood of a maiden is two hundred (Zuz), and that of a widow (remarried) is one hundred (Zuz, a common Shekel).

<cite ref="Bava Kamma 90b:6">B. Kam. 90ᵇ</cite> <he>מ׳ צורי תנן או מ׳ מדינה תנן</he> does the Mishnah (<cite ref="Mishnah Sanhedrin 8:6">Snh. VIII, 6</cite>) mean a Tyrian or a country Maneh (twelve and a half Zuz)? <cite ref="Mishnah Shevuot 6:1">Shebu. VI, 1</cite> <he>מ׳ לי בידך</he> thou owest me one hundred denars.
<cite ref="Mishnah Sanhedrin 8:2">Snh. VIII, 2</cite> <he>מ׳ בשר</he> meat of the weight of a Maneh.
<cite ref="Mishnah Sheviit 1:2">Shebi. I, 2</cite> <he>ששים מ׳ באיטלקי</he> the weight of sixty M. in the Italian system.
Erub. 85ᵃ bot. פנו מקום לבן מאה מ׳ make room for one worth one hundred M. (in gold).—Trnsf. מ׳ בן פרס a Maneh son of a P’ras (half a Maneh), i.e. a distinguished son of a less distinguished father.

<cite ref="Taanit 21b:6">Taan. 21ᵇ</cite>.—Pl. <he>מָנִים</he>, <he>מָנִין</he>. Y. Shek. VI, 49ᶜ bot. <he>אלף … מ׳</he> the weight of fifteen hundred M. Ker. l. c.; a. e.—Chald. form: <cite ref="M01771"><he>מָנֵי</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Ezekiel 45:12">Targ. Ez. XLV, 12</cite> (Kimḥi <cite ref="M00048"><he>מָנָא</he></cite>).—Pl. <he>מָנִין</he>, <he>מָנַיָּא</he>, <cite ref="M01796"><he>מָנָן</he></cite>, <he>מָנָאֵי</he>, <he>מָנוֹי</he>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Isaiah 7:23">Targ. Is. VII, 23</cite>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on I Kings 10:17">Targ. I Kings X, 17</cite>; a. e.—
<cite ref="Esther Rabbah 10:4">Esth. R. to VI, 10</cite>; <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 28:6">Lev. R. s. 28</cite>.—
Sabb. 133ᵇ שב מ׳ תרבא (not מינאי, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 90) fat weighing seven M. (Rashi: seven portions of fat).
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Bava Kamma 9:3:3">Y. B. Kam. IX, 6ᵈ</cite> bot. [read as Tosaf. to Bab.
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 100b">B. Kam. 100ᵇ</cite>:) <he>חמש מנוי עמר וח׳ מ׳ סממנין וכ׳</he> wool worth five M., dyeing material worth five, and ten M. wages.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Megillah 4:1:9">Y. Meg. IV, 74ᵈ</cite> bot. <he>מניי</he> (corr. acc.); a. e.
